description: Append a decision (or an incident) to an AI system's signed, append-only record, by the rules of POST /v1/ai/systems/{id}/records. Send the input and output text or their SHA-256: only the hash is kept, never the text. Nothing recorded can be edited or removed, so record what actually happened, not a guess.

input.description: The input, as text or JSON. Hashed, then dropped.

output.description: The output, as text or JSON. Hashed, then dropped.

output_label.description: A short readable label, e.g. suspect, clear.

ref_id.description: For an incident: the decision (air_…) it is about.

subject.description: What it was about: a unit, GTIN + serial, case id.

name: record_ai_decision
title: record_ai_decision
